@@ -58,3 +58,5 @@ Setting `SFL_ENABLED=false` pauses request processing and result observation. It
 If multiple review requests overlap on one head, a terminal older request does not authorize skipping the unresolved request between it and a later request. Advance the branch to a new head for unambiguous recovery. Context-invalid requests retain a failed gate with that instruction. The observer accepts both authenticated clean-review phrases, "Didn't find any major issues." and "Did not find any major issues.", after the same head, base, App and registration checks.
 
 A registered review author can edit or delete their request to invalidate its result after their write access is revoked. Current write access is still required to authorize a review. Comment runs bind to the comment ID and marker intent captured in their event payload. A current writer request stays serialized while its CLI registry becomes visible, including when its body is later erased. Ordinary comments need an actual registry to block publication. Unprivileged commenters receive one historical-registry lookup without retry waits. Older deployed run titles lack this distinction and remain conservative during cutover. Retarget events invalidate a review only when moving to or departing from the default branch; changes between non-default branches remain outside reviewer admission.
+
+Registered request history must retain a nonempty context without surrounding whitespace. Successful required-status repairs recheck current request history before and after writing; an intervening edit or deletion restores the blocking status.
